name: claudepeeker
description: Your status line, drawn by a mod above the prompt: model, effort, branch, context and rate-limit bars, with bar styles and reset time formats in /config

ctxStyle.title: Context bar style
ctxStyle.description: The look of the context bar (ctx). blocks: █ on ░, the tip easing by eighths of a cell while the bar grows. parallelogram: ▰ on ▱. shade: ▓ on ░. solid: █ on a gray █. smooth: █ on ░, the edge always by eighths of a cell. smooth-bare: the same on blank. line: ━ on ─. heavy: a bold ━ on a dim ━. dots: ● on ○. squares: ■ on □. diamonds: ◆ on ◇. braille: ⣿ on ⣀. ascii: # on - between [ and ], for fonts without these glyphs. arrow: ===> between [ and ]. pie: one glyph, ○ ◔ ◑ ◕ ●. spark: one glyph, ▁ to █. none: no bar, the percent alone.

ctxWidth.title: Context bar width
ctxWidth.description: How many cells the context bar takes: 3 to 20. pie, spark and none ignore it.

fiveStyle.title: 5h bar style
fiveStyle.description: The look of the 5-hour limit bar (5h). blocks: █ on ░, the tip easing by eighths of a cell while the bar grows. parallelogram: ▰ on ▱. shade: ▓ on ░. solid: █ on a gray █. smooth: █ on ░, the edge always by eighths of a cell. smooth-bare: the same on blank. line: ━ on ─. heavy: a bold ━ on a dim ━. dots: ● on ○. squares: ■ on □. diamonds: ◆ on ◇. braille: ⣿ on ⣀. ascii: # on - between [ and ], for fonts without these glyphs. arrow: ===> between [ and ]. pie: one glyph, ○ ◔ ◑ ◕ ●. spark: one glyph, ▁ to █. none: no bar, the percent alone.

fiveWidth.title: 5h bar width
fiveWidth.description: How many cells the 5-hour bar takes: 3 to 20. pie, spark and none ignore it.

weekStyle.title: Weekly bar style
weekStyle.description: The look of the weekly limit bar (wk). blocks: █ on ░, the tip easing by eighths of a cell while the bar grows. parallelogram: ▰ on ▱. shade: ▓ on ░. solid: █ on a gray █. smooth: █ on ░, the edge always by eighths of a cell. smooth-bare: the same on blank. line: ━ on ─. heavy: a bold ━ on a dim ━. dots: ● on ○. squares: ■ on □. diamonds: ◆ on ◇. braille: ⣿ on ⣀. ascii: # on - between [ and ], for fonts without these glyphs. arrow: ===> between [ and ]. pie: one glyph, ○ ◔ ◑ ◕ ●. spark: one glyph, ▁ to █. none: no bar, the percent alone.

weekWidth.title: Weekly bar width
weekWidth.description: How many cells the weekly bar takes: 3 to 20. pie, spark and none ignore it.

fiveTime.title: 5h reset time
fiveTime.description: How the 5-hour reset time reads. relative: the time left (2h13m). clock: the local time (13:50, or Fri 05:00 when it is not today). date: the day, month and time (10/10 13:50). A click on the time in the status line steps to the next one.

weekTime.title: Weekly reset time
weekTime.description: How the weekly reset time reads. relative: the time left (6d17h). clock: the local time (Fri 05:00, or 13:50 when it is today). date: the day, month and time (17/10 05:00). A click on the time in the status line steps to the next one.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: How the bars move when a figure changes. lively: a glint sweeps the bar, the fill grows and blends its color, the percent and the tokens roll with the changed digits flashing; crossing 50% or 80% pulses the bar, a compaction drains the ctx bar with sparkles, a reset flashes the bar green, and the working dot dims and brightens every half second. subtle: the same, softer, with no sparkles and the dot changing every second. off: a still line, redrawn after each response.
